title: Enforce-or-remove: four metadata shapes cloud's authoring rules warn about still parse clean (boolean required, open flow start config, orphan action nodes, roll-up filter keys)
body:
repo:cloud#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AdARJtc4RgABPH7PHk

Filing gate: **① declared-but-unenforced shapes with named producers**, the enforce-or-remove (E/R) rows of the #31155 no-loss ledger (comment `6711215678`), verified one by one against `packages/spec` and `packages/lint` on `main`. Under cloud#3659 ruling A these traps are NOT written into `@objectstack/skills` as prose; the spec (or lint at build) should refuse them. Reader: triage routes (expected `domain:spec`, with lint where noted).

## 维护者速读

把 cloud 私有的 AI 编写规则搬进公开 skills 时,有几条其实是「这样写能通过校验,但运行时没效果」的陷阱。按「声明即强制」,这类问题应该让 spec 在发布时直接拒绝,而不是写一段提醒。逐条核对后,剩下 4 处 spec/lint 确实还没拦住,汇成这张卡。

## Candidates (verified on `main`)

**A. Boolean / toggle `required: true`.** Admitted by `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:1323` (`required: z.boolean().default(false)`); no boolean arm in the field `superRefine`, `kernel/functional-completeness.ts` (`checkFieldCompleteness` has summary/formula/choice arms only) or lint. Producer: cloud's build agent (cloud#972 incident). The runtime "can never fire / refuses the unchecked state" claim is the ledger's; trace it before choosing refuse vs. ignore.

**B. The flow `start` node's `config` has no schema** (cross-cutting; it is why three ledger rows cannot be refused by a strict object). `automation/builtin-node-config.zod.ts` and `schemaless-node-config.zod.ts` carry no `start` config (`SCHEMALESS_NODE_CONFIG_SCHEMAS` = script / subflow / decision). Consequences: (i) a sibling `filter` beside `timeRelative` parses (no reader found in `trigger-schedule/src/time-relative-plugin.ts`); (ii) a `schedule` cadence beside `timeRelative` is never judged (`time-relative-trigger.zod.ts:27,43,114-121` say the cadence is the sweep interval, daily 08:00 UTC by default); (iii) `config.schedule.timezone` is described and IANA-checked on `CronScheduleSchema` (`system/job.zod.ts:61`) but an author of a flow never meets that schema. Expected: a strict `start` config schema (or the checks in `FlowSchema`'s `superRefine`).

**C. An action node no edge reaches** parses and never runs: `automation/flow.zod.ts` `FlowSchema.superRefine` (`:1443`, edge region ~`:1815-1870`) refuses duplicate ids, dangling endpoints and repeated edges, but no reachability rule was found in spec or lint. ⚠️ Confirm `validateControlFlow` / `analyzeRegion` do not already cover it before building.

**D. `summaryOperations.filter` keys / select values are not judged against the CHILD object**: the spec admits any `FilterConditionSchema` (`data/field.zod.ts:2186`); lint `data-model-rules.ts:835-870` judges the child only for the aggregand field type. A key that is not a child field never matches and the roll-up stays 0. ⚠️ Not exhaustively searched.

## Already enforced (no work; the ledger rows are stale)

- Summary without `summaryOperations`: refused at lint (`kernel/functional-completeness.ts:110,165-177`, severity error, wired in `os lint`), admitted at parse; runtime warns only.
- Schedule / time-relative flow at `runAs: 'user'` with a data node: lint `FLOW_RUNAS_UNSCOPED` (`lint-flow-patterns.ts:232`) fails the build.
- Dashboard dimension over a multi-value field: partly covered for datasets (`validate-dataset-measure-aggregates.ts:151`); inline widget `dimensions` in `ui/dashboard.zod.ts` not checked.

Dedupe (objectstack issues, open and closed): one search per row (summary / summaryOperations; boolean required checkbox; flow orphan unreachable; timeRelative filter sibling; timeRelative cadence; timeRelative runAs; summaryOperations filter child; schedule timezone; dashboard dimensions multiselect) — #31155 is the top hit each time; nothing open carries these.

Priority suggestion: p2 (each is a silent no-op an AI author can write today; none is a data-loss path).
